title: SA&I APAC Data Management (DM) Transformation Leader
description:
**Job Description**

The SA&I APAC DM Transformation Leader will spearhead the transformation of Data Management capabilities and Multi -Country Projects across APAC, driving standardization, automation, AI adoption, quality excellence, and scalable delivery models. This role will be responsible for modernizing the end-to-end Data Management ecosystem, aligning regional execution with global standards while improving speed, quality, productivity, and commercial competitiveness. The need for stronger DM transformation, AI-led efficiencies, quality enhancement, and closer integration between regional and global operations is a key pillar of the APAC Operations Transformation agenda.

The role will act as the strategic bridge between APAC markets, Global Data Management, Global Operations, Quality, Technology, and Commercial teams to establish a future-ready AI-enabled Data Management function.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Management Transformation Strategy**

* Develop and execute the APAC Data Management Transformation roadmap.
* Define the future-state operating model for Data Management across APAC.
* Lead large-scale transformation initiatives across scripting, data processing, tabulation, quality control, automation, and reporting.
* Build a multi-year capability roadmap aligned with APAC growth priorities.

**AI & Automation Enablement**

* Drive adoption of Agentic AI, GenAI, workflow automation, and intelligent quality control solutions across DM operations.
* Partner with technology teams and external vendors to implement AI-enabled Data Processing and Survey Programming capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, eliminate repetitive activities, and improve turnaround times.
* Build business cases and measure realized benefits from automation initiatives.
* Lead implementation of zero-touch or low-touch data management workflows.

**Data Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Establish robust data quality frameworks and governance standards.
* Drive continuous improvement in data validation, data processing accuracy, coding consistency, and tabulation quality.
* Implement proactive quality monitoring and predictive risk identification.
* Lead root-cause analysis and preventive action programs.
* Partner with Operations Excellence to drive First-Time-Right delivery.

**Standardization & Process Governance**

* Standardize scripting, coding, tabulation, data processing, and delivery methodologies across APAC.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks, templates, and best-practice frameworks.
* Reduce market-specific variations while preserving critical client requirements.
* Ensure consistent governance, auditability, and compliance across all Data Management activities.

**Capability Building & Talent Development**

* Build APAC Data Management capability strategy.
* Develop future-ready talent in AI-enabled Data Management, advanced scripting, automation, analytics, and quality management.
* Lead training, certification, mentoring, and capability development programs.
* Identify and build specialist talent pools to support APAC growth priorities.

**Global Alignment & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary APAC liaison between Regional Operations and Global Data Management teams.
* Drive adoption of global DM standards, processes, and technologies.
* Partner with Commercial, CS, Operations, and Delivery teams to improve client outcomes.
* Influence senior stakeholders to support and accelerate transformation initiatives.

**Performance Management & KPI Governance**

* Define and govern Data Management KPIs across APAC.
* Track productivity, quality, automation adoption, turnaround times, and capacity utilization.
* Develop executive dashboards to support decision-making.
* Establish workload drivers and benchmarking standards across markets.

**Commercial & Client Impact**

* Support proposal teams through efficient and scalable DM solutions.
* Improve delivery speed and project profitability through automation and standardization.
* Enable innovative methodologies leveraging AI and advanced technologies.
* Support strategic growth opportunities and operational scalability.

 **Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Data Management, Data Processing, Survey Programming, Analytics Operations, Market Research Operations, or Business Process Transformation.
* Proven experience leading large-scale transformation and change initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of survey scripting, data processing, tabulation, coding, and reporting workflows.
* Experience managing regional and multi-country operational teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience within Market Research, Consumer Insights, or Analytics industries.
* Expertise with AI, Automation, RPA, Agentic AI, and workflow technologies.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience implementing operational excellence and quality frameworks.
* Experience working within global shared-service or CoE environments.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
Job Description: The Assistant Manager (AM) is responsible for leading a team of customer support executives across Chat, Email, and Voice channels. This role focuses on building high-performing teams, ensuring service excellence, driving operational efficiency, and meeting both qualitative and quantitative business KPIs. The AM plays a key role in coaching, mentoring, performance management, workforce alignment, SLA adherence, and continuous process improvement.

  

**Responsibilities: Performance Management**

* Track and manage individual and team performance against defined KPIs (AHT, CSAT, QA, Productivity, Utilization, etc.).
* Conduct monthly/quarterly performance reviews and create action plans for performance improvement.
* Use data-driven insights to guide coaching, feedback, and performance decisions.
* Partner with HR for performance improvement plans, rewards & recognition, and compliance with organizational guidelines.
* **Operational & Team Management**
* Oversee day-to-day operations for Chat, Email, and Voice queues to ensure smooth functioning and optimal staffing.
* Monitor real-time performance dashboards and take corrective actions to manage volumes and workload allocation.
* Coordinate with WFM for roster planning, shrinkage control, adherence, and schedule optimization.
* Escalate operational risks, system issues, or challenges proactively.
* **SLA Management**
* Ensure adherence to all SLAs across response time, resolution time, AHT, contact handling efficiency, and backlog management.
* Analyze SLA breaches and drive root-cause analysis with preventive and corrective measures.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve process gaps impacting SLA performance.
* Maintain governance through daily/weekly SLA performance reviews.
* **Quality Management**
* Ensure high-quality customer interactions by collaborating with QA teams on audits, feedback loops, and training needs.
* Analyze quality reports to identify trends, behavior patterns, and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct refresher training, calibration sessions, and quality workshops to ensure consistent service standards.
* Drive initiatives that improve CSAT, NPS, FCR, and other experience metrics.
* **Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with Operations Leaders, Quality, WFM, Training, and Product/Policy teams to align operational goals.
* Drive continuous improvement projects based on customer pain points, process gaps, or agent performance needs.
* Represent the team in internal reviews, business updates, and performance discussions.
* **Reporting & Analytics**
* Generate and review daily, weekly, and monthly reports on performance metrics.
* Identify trends and insights to guide strategic and operational decision-making.
* Present dashboards, RCA documents, action plans, and performance stories to leadership.

  

* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 3–5 years of experience in customer support operations, including team leadership roles.
* Strong knowledge of Chat, Email, and Voice support workflows.
* Experience managing KPIs such as SLA, AHT, CSAT, QA, and Productivity.

title: HR Operations Executive
description:
**Company:** Persistent Systems  
**Job Title:** HR Operations Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources / HR Operations  
**Industry:** IT Services and Digital Transformation  
**Experience:** Entry-Level to 3 Years (as per business requirements)  
**Qualification:** Graduate in HR, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline preferred  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

About Persistent Systems

Persistent Systems is an Indian technology services company specializing in software engineering, digital transformation, and technology-driven business solutions. The company focuses on delivering innovative solutions and supporting efficient business operations through technology and skilled professionals.

Job Summary

Persistent Systems is looking for a detail-oriented and organized **HR Operations Executive** to support employee onboarding, maintain employee master data, verify joining documents, and update Human Resource Management System (HRMS) records. The candidate will also be responsible for preparing HR reports, maintaining onboarding trackers, validating employee information, and coordinating with HR teams to resolve data discrepancies.

The ideal candidate should have good knowledge of HR operations, employee documentation, Microsoft Excel, HRMS platforms, and data validation, along with strong organizational and communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

* **Employee Onboarding:** Support the onboarding process by coordinating joining formalities, collecting employee information, and ensuring completion of required documentation.
* **Employee Documentation:** Verify joining documents, maintain employee files, and ensure that records are complete, accurate, and properly organized.
* **HRMS Management:** Create and update employee profiles, maintain employee master data, and ensure accurate information in the HRMS.
* **Data Validation:** Review employee records to identify missing information, duplicate entries, inconsistent details, and data-entry errors.
* **Employee Master Data Management:** Maintain accurate records of employee details, joining dates, designations, departments, locations, and employment status.
* **HR Reporting:** Prepare headcount reports, onboarding trackers, attrition summaries, and employee-status reports using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools.
* **Excel and Data Analysis:** Use Excel functions, filters, sorting, lookup formulas, PivotTables, and data validation techniques to maintain and analyze HR data.
* **Discrepancy Resolution:** Coordinate with HR teams and relevant stakeholders to correct missing, inaccurate, or duplicate employee records.
* **Onboarding Tracker Management:** Update joining trackers, monitor pending documentation, and follow up on incomplete onboarding activities.
* **Employee Lifecycle Support:** Assist with employee status updates, transfers, internal movements, and separation-related data updates as required.
* **Process Compliance:** Follow established HR policies, standard operating procedures, documentation requirements, and data privacy guidelines.
* **Audit and Record Maintenance:** Maintain organized employee records and support internal audits and HR data verification activities.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Communicate with recruiters, HR business partners, payroll teams, and employees to obtain accurate information and resolve documentation issues.
* **Confidentiality:** Ensure the secure handling of employee personal information and comply with applicable data protection policies.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in HR operations, HR administration, employee data management, or onboarding is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including formulas, sorting, filtering, and PivotTables.
* Familiarity with HRMS platforms and employee database management.
* Understanding of employee onboarding procedures and joining documentation.
* Strong data-entry accuracy and data-validation skills.
* Ability to identify duplicate records, missing fields, and inconsistencies in employee information.
* Good organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle confidential employee information responsibly.
* Willingness to work with HR teams to maintain accurate and timely records.

Required Skills

* HR Operations and Administration
* Employee Onboarding and Documentation
* Employee Master Data Management
* Human Resource Management Systems (HRMS)
* Microsoft Excel and Data Analysis
* Data Validation and Data Cleaning
* Headcount and Attrition Reporting
* Onboarding Tracker Management
* Employee Records Management
* Reporting and Documentation
* Attention to Detail
* Communication and Coordination
* Data Privacy and Confidentiality

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and completeness of employee master data.
* Timely completion of onboarding documentation.
* Accuracy of HRMS updates and employee records.
* Timeliness and accuracy of headcount and attrition reports.
* Number of duplicate or incomplete records identified and resolved.
* Adherence to HR processes and documentation standards.
* Timely closure of data discrepancies.
* Compliance with employee data privacy requirements.

Work Environment

The HR Operations Executive will work closely with HR operations, recruitment, payroll, and other internal teams. The role involves employee data management, document verification, HRMS updates, reporting, and administrative support to ensure smooth and accurate HR operations.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented and process-driven professional with strong Excel skills, an understanding of HR operations, and the ability to maintain accurate employee records. They should be comfortable handling large datasets, preparing HR reports, validating information, and coordinating with stakeholders while maintaining confidentiality and data accuracy.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Purpose**

Acts as the focal point for all people-related activities pertaining to the assigned country. Partners with Managers, other P&O functions, and employees to ensure all P&O programs and policies are properly implemented within assigned units. Handles all operational P&O matters, ensuring that ADES satisfies the industry standards, country regulations, and client training and personnel requirements.

**JOB ROLE:**

**Employee Onboarding:**

* Coordinate and facilitate the onboarding process for new employees, ensuring all necessary paperwork, identification, training, regulatory, and compliance documents are completed.
* Liaise with functional/operational managers to fulfill workforce plans that are appropriate for their business needs, within ADES’s overall recruitment strategy and guidelines to ensure no shortage in manning.
* Accountable for managing the onboarding process of the assigned crew to ensure 100% of hired crew board the rigs in a timely and smooth manner.
* Responsible for ensuring that the hiring/rig Manager completes the Probation Period Evaluation on Oracle in a timely manner.

**Contract Issuance:**

* Ensures employment contracts for all ADES employees have been accurately and timely issued, and properly archived post-signature.

**Crew Management:**

* Collaborates with team leaders, rig manager, and relevant departments to prepare crew schedules.
* Inform crew members of their schedules, duty locations, and any updates, ensuring timely and clear communication.
* Manages emergency evacuation in injury or illness cases to ensure all is done in a timely manner.
* Liaises with the Admin Manager to ensure the necessary Permits for all crew members is valid and up to date.
* Leave management:
* Manage transportation and accommodation arrangements for crew members as per company policies
* Manage and update employee files, including training certifications, and other mandatory documents.
* Collect and verify time sheets, attendance records, and other payroll-related information for timely submission.
* Assist in month-end payroll processing, ensuring accuracy and timely payment for all employees.
* Reimbursement processing.

* Liaises with the Employee Service Specialist to ensure completion of the hiring/exit document signatures and benefits enrollment/removal for new employees/leavers and their dependents.

**Personnel:**

* Maintains, updates, and ensures the integrity of all Employee Data and Transactions on all P&OIS platforms (i.e., Oracle, Skills VX, …etc.)

* Initiates and acquires approvals for any change of employee status/employment letters (i.e., promotion, transfer, …etc.) according to pay scale, upon the request of the People Operations Director.
* Answers any questions employees have about their benefits and contracts.

**Disciplinary Actions:**

* Act as a point of contact for employees’ concerns and grievances, providing guidance and escalating issues to HR as necessary.
* Support in implementing grievance procedures and documenting resolutions to maintain a positive work environment.
* Responsible for administering disciplinary actions in accordance with company policy and local laws with advice from the People operation Manager/ Country People Manager in consultation with operations.

**Benefits Enrollment:**

* Accountable for the enrollment, update of entry, and deletion of all ADES employees in the appropriate medical and life insurance providers as per the approved matrix.

**Training & Compliance:**

* Confirms rig's training plan quarterly, liaises with the Training team and logistics to ensure that all assigned employees have attended required trainings, and ensures training certifications are uploaded on the system.
* Always maintains the Assigned rig’s training compliance above the approved target.

**Employee Performance:**

* Follows up with the Rig Manager on Performance Appraisal Process in the Country to ensure that all is done in time and in accordance with the company policy and guidelines.

**Communications:**

* Maintains a regular communication channel with the Rig Manager, OIM, and crew (whether onboard or offboard) and responds to their inquiries and requests in a timely manner.
* Conduct periodic Rig Visits as per the target set.

**Checklists and Reports:**

* Ensure that all tasks as outlined in the checklists are covered and provide a rig visit report within 48 hours of the Rig Visit.
* Prepare and provide any requested P&O reports in a timely manner.

**Exit Management:**

* ·Manages employee Exit Processes/interviews and issues Exit documents, release letters, and necessary letters of experience, and liaises with the payroll team to finalize employee final settlement.

title: Looking for Personal Secretary
description:
Roles and Responsibilities are as follows -

1. Answering Calls, Taking Messages, and Handling Correspondence

Secretaries serve as the first point of contact for clients, partners, and internal teams. They manage phone lines, direct inquiries, screen calls, and ensure that communications are documented and followed up on promptly. This ensures professionalism and responsiveness in all external and internal interactions.

2. Maintaining Diaries and Arranging Appointments

Efficient time management is essential for leadership and team coordination. Secretaries manage calendars, schedule meetings, and avoid conflicts to ensure productivity. They act as gatekeepers, allowing executives to focus on strategic responsibilities without administrative overload.

3. Typing, Preparing, and Collating Reports

Whether it's drafting letters, writing proposals, or compiling performance reports, secretaries play a central role in the production of professional documents. They ensure accuracy, formatting consistency, and timely delivery of materials used in decision-making processes.

4. Filing and Documentation

Organizing physical and digital records is a critical administrative function. Secretaries maintain secure, well-structured systems that ensure quick access to important documents and compliance with information governance policies.

5. Organizing and Servicing Meetings

From scheduling and setting up meeting rooms to preparing agendas and recording minutes, secretaries are key to effective meeting management. Their detailed notes help ensure clear follow-up and accountability on action points.

6. Managing Databases

A secretary often manages databases containing client details, vendor records, or HR information. This includes regular updates, data integrity checks, and sometimes analysis, making sure that critical information is accurate and accessible when needed.

7. Prioritizing Workloads

With multiple responsibilities competing for attention, secretaries must constantly assess and adjust priorities. They juggle urgent tasks, manage time-sensitive deadlines, and support team members in optimizing their schedules.

8. Implementing New Procedures and Administrative Systems

Secretaries often identify opportunities for administrative improvements. Whether it’s transitioning to cloud-based systems, digitizing records, or streamlining workflows, they help implement smarter ways of working across departments.

9. Liaising with Relevant Organizations and Clients

Communication with external stakeholders is a key part of the role. Secretaries coordinate with vendors, clients, and partners, ensuring all interactions are professional, timely, and aligned with business goals.

10. Coordinating Mail-shots and Similar Publicity Tasks

Supporting marketing or outreach functions, some administrators assist in the distribution of newsletters, promotional materials, and public announcements. This often involves working with CRM tools or mailing platforms to maintain contact lists.

11. Logging or Processing Bills and Expenses

Financial support tasks such as tracking departmental expenses, processing payments, and managing petty cash often fall under a secretary’s remit. Their attention to detail ensures financial accuracy and proper reporting.

12. Acting as a Receptionist and Greeting Clients

In many organizations, secretaries also manage front-desk duties. They provide a warm welcome to visitors, manage guest logs, and maintain a professional office atmosphere while balancing their administrative tasks.

13. Recruiting, Supervising, and Training Junior Staff

In more senior roles, secretaries contribute to team development. This includes assisting in the hiring process, onboarding new staff, delegating tasks, and ensuring junior administrators are trained in office procedures.

14. Tracking and Ordering Office Supplies

Administrators ensure that the office is always fully equipped by managing inventory, monitoring supply usage, and negotiating with suppliers. This task helps avoid disruptions and keeps operations running smoothly.

15. Maintaining Confidentiality

Perhaps one of the most critical aspects of the role is the ability to manage sensitive information with discretion. Secretaries handle confidential reports, personnel files, and business strategies, and must ensure strict compliance with data protection policies.

16. Supporting Executive Decision-Making

Many experienced secretaries help leaders by preparing reports, gathering information, organising presentations, and ensuring executives have the materials needed for important meetings. This support improves decision-making speed and efficiency.

**You will translate diverse cross\-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Logical \& Physical Data Model Design:**


	+ **Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and** **Logical Data Models (LDM)** **across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.**
	+ **Translate LDMs into optimized** **Physical Data Models (PDM)** **tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.**
	+ **Reverse\-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.**
	+ **Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity\-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.**
* **Domain Alignment \& Standards Governance:**


	+ **Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.**
	+ **Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.**
	+ **Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross\-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.**
* **Cross\-Functional Technical Collaboration:**


	+ **Work hand\-in\-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.**
	+ **Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.**
	+ **Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.**
* **Model Optimization \& Quality:**


	+ **Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.**
	+ **Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.**

**Qualifications**

* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** **focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.**
* **Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity\-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.**
* **Strong proficiency in** **SQL** **for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.**
* **Hands\-on experience with modern** **cloud data warehouses** **(preferably** **GCP BigQuery****, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.**
* **Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).**
* **Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.**
* **Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.**

**Preferred Skills**

* **Experience with** **Data Vault 2\.0** **modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.**

* **Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).**
* **Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.**
